A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ROVA/PVRBench work. All 36 pages, including Appendices A–I, were readable and compared through text extraction and rendering; no material gaps limit comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original ROVA evaluations on PVRBench (Table 2), training-efficiency measurements (Table 3), and additional experiments, ablations and case studies in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original benchmark evaluations, training-efficiency measurements, ablations and qualitative results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same structured corruption, difficulty-aware selection, memory re-evaluation, dual-branch rewards and GRPO training procedure.

E1.justification: Training data and PVRBench, VisBench and UrbanVideo evaluation coverage are unchanged, including the same indoor/outdoor tasks and perturbation scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in the PVRBench evaluation (Table 2), training-efficiency comparison (Table 3), alternative-reward comparison (Table 15) and other reported experiments.

E3.justification: The same evaluation metrics, model configurations, training budgets, preprocessing and testing procedures are reported throughout Sections 4–5 and the appendices.

E4.justification: Both retain identical component ablations, hyperparameter and frame-count sensitivity analyses, curriculum analyses, reward comparisons and qualitative case studies.

E5.justification: Appendix G.2 retains the three-run disclosure for training-ratio measurements, and Table 13 retains the same plus/minus timing reporting. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results, rankings, trends and qualitative examples match across the main text and appendices. No result entries are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: The equations and mathematical reasoning are identical, including Appendix G's cost proposition and proof and Appendix I's KL/Fisher assumptions and derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims introducing ROVA and PVRBench, improving corruption robustness and transferring improvements to clean benchmarks.

C2.justification: Interpretations of robustness, curriculum behavior and reward design are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same limitations concerning binary rewards, fixed weighting, judge dependence and holistic feedback.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, prompts, data-construction details and project-access information are unchanged, including Section 5.1 and Appendices B–D.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography are identical, preserving the same cited works and positioning relative to earlier robustness and video-reasoning research.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v2, 14 Apr 2026 to v3, 30 Jun 2026, with its hyperlink updated accordingly. The paper's wording and section structure otherwise match.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and body layouts are unchanged. Pages 2–36 render identically, and the first-page body also matches after excluding the administrative margin stamp.

improvement.justification: The only differences are the administrative arXiv version/date stamp and its version link. Scientific content, evidence, limitations, reproducibility information and body presentation are identical, so these updates do not meaningfully change overall paper quality.
